pageAnatomy: Record detail drawer with timeline and evidence
Visible empty, loading, error and permission states
crossCutting.rolesRule: All page.roles values are illustrative preview filters, not authorization. Owner mode exposes the whole proposed architecture for design review; this does not grant a production owner unrestricted data access. Production navigation and actions must derive from existing server-enforced permissions, branch/department scope, value/state rules and maker-checker authority. Filter each page, not only the module.
crossCutting.payrollRule: Payroll is an independently restricted page even inside People. Own self-service stays own-record scoped. Forbid casual owner/manager/employee role fallbacks.
dataRules: Always distinguish a missing value from zero.
Separate physical quantity, available quantity and reservation.
Separate delivery outcome, payment outcome and cash reconciliation.
Keep unsynced operations visible and never label them completed merely because they were queued.
crossCutting.reuseRule: One authoritative stock ledger, order lifecycle, customer profile and finance record. Multiple role-specific screens are views or tasks over the same records, not parallel implementations.
crossCutting.deploymentRule: Mapped source served-state is the catalogue declaration only. Verify actual runtime routes before implementation or any deployment claim.
specialSurfaces: POS has a focused till layout with scan input, basket, tender and peripheral state.
Floor, backstore, picker and driver handhelds use task-first mobile layouts with large targets and persistent sync state.
Owner sees cross-branch decision summaries; each operator sees their assigned scope.
Customer web/app, supplier portal and B2B portal are separate external experiences; these ERP tiles manage them without pretending to design every external page.

rolePreviewDefinitions.owner: Design-review mode showing the complete architecture; not unrestricted real account access.
rolePreviewDefinitions.manager: Store-management work; payroll, private rights requests and privileged administration hidden.
rolePreviewDefinitions.buyer: Buying, catalogue and supplier work; operational and financial links only where needed.
rolePreviewDefinitions.warehouse: Receiving, backstore, stock and fulfilment tasks; no general finance or administration.
rolePreviewDefinitions.floor: Floor work and illustrative handheld fulfilment tasks; real picker/driver permissions remain separate.
rolePreviewDefinitions.cashier: Till, returns, pickup and limited customer-service work, plus own staff tasks.
rolePreviewDefinitions.finance: Accounting, reconciliation, payables, authorized payroll and financial reporting; actual grants still required.

crossCutting.ownProfileRule: Profile access belongs to the global header and is own-account only. It is not permission to enter Administration. My self-service remains own-record scoped.
